ice.text: Kjeldor is founded by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, who leave Storgard before the ice covers it, and it trades with Fyndhorn, whose elves teach its healers in exchange for keeping orcs at bay.

Balduvia declares war over ancestral lands around 2500 AR, beginning 400 years of strife, and in the Balesh Pass battles Kjeldor's pikemen and knights rout the orcs at first before goblins distract the knights so the orcs can flank them.
By 2934 Kjeldor is weak and decentralized, and Avram Garrison, aided by Lim-Dul, forms the Knights of Stromgald and attempts a coup, which fails when Varchild defends the king.

Darien takes firm control, unites the army under General Varchild and allies with the Balduvians against Lim-Dul, and after the Thaw he and Lovisa merge their nations into New Argive, with Darien killing Haakon in the Battle of Kjeldor.

csp.text: Kjeldor faces the Knights of Stromgald, who strike Darien's Roost from two sides, but Darien's tacticians prevent a pincer attack on the realm.
Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw, and the bond between Yavimaya and New Argive is forged.
With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
